matrix_definition.reduced_matrix: K^(r) is obtained by deleting root row r and root column r.
matrix_definition.self_loop_cancellation: T(x,x) is excluded from K[x,x]; self-loops contribute neither diagonal nor off-diagonal arborescence weight.

parallel_multiplicity: Multiplicity T(x,y) is retained as an integer coefficient; no simple-support collapse is permitted.

row_decomposition.arc_row: b_{x->y}=e_x-e_y if y in V; b_{x->r}=e_x.
row_decomposition.basis: For V=A\{r}, let e_x be the coordinate row basis on V.
